column3: Check that the word family actually has the required forms; not every word does. Examples: We decide together. The decision was difficult. She gave a decisive answer. Identify the verb, noun and adjective role in each sentence.

column2: O‘yin xatosini ma’no, imlo yoki collocation deb ajrating. So‘zni to‘g‘ri ma’nosi bilan ko‘ring, tarjimasiz eslang, o‘z gapingizni yozing va birozdan keyin yana tekshiring. Bir xatoni tez-tez qaytarish o‘rniga xato sababini tuzating.
column3: Classify the error as sense, spelling or collocation. Check the item, retrieve it without translation, write a personal sentence and revisit it later. Change the mistaken association rather than repeating the same unsuccessful guess.

column2: Qisqa placement natijasi dastlabki yo‘nalish, to‘liq CEFR sertifikati emas. Savollar soni, qamrab olingan skill va taxminiy javoblarni tekshiring. Yuqori natijani Writing/Speaking namunalari va uzunroq tushunish vazifasi bilan tekshirmasdan haqiqiy C2 deb e’lon qilmang.
column3: A short placement result is an initial indication, not a full CEFR certification. Check test length, skills covered and guessed answers. Validate a high result using productive tasks and broader comprehension before treating it as confirmed C2 ability.

column2: Taxminiy to‘g‘ri javobni bilgan javobdan keyin ajrating: javob sababini variantsiz tushuntira olasizmi? O‘xshash yangi savolda tekshiring. MCQdagi tasodifiy topish natijani oshirishi mumkin; aniq nechta javob tasodifiyligini matndan hisoblab bera olmayman.
column3: After the test, explain each uncertain answer without the choices and try a fresh equivalent item. Guessing can inflate an MCQ result, but the text alone cannot reveal exactly how many correct answers were accidental.

column2: Natija sahifasidagi skill breakdownni solishtiring, faqat umumiy balga qaramang. Past aniqlik va takroriy xato ko‘p bo‘lgan skillga kichik mashq tanlang. Har bo‘lim savollari turlicha bo‘lsa foiz va savol sonini birga ko‘ring; natijangizsiz eng zaif skillni taxmin qilmayman.
column3: Compare the skill breakdown, considering accuracy and question count rather than total score alone. Start with a small exercise targeting recurring errors. Without your actual results, I cannot identify which skill lowered the score most.

column2: 7 kunlik reja qisqa maqsad yoki odatni sinash uchun, 30 kunlik reja muntazam rivojlantirish uchun qulay. Vaqt va vazifa hajmi bajariladigan bo‘lsin. Reja davomiyligi ma’lum band yoki darajaga yetishni kafolatlamaydi; bir haftadan so‘ng yuklamani qayta baholang.
column3: A seven-day plan suits a short goal or trial routine; thirty days supports sustained practice. Choose a workload you can complete. Plan length does not guarantee a band or level; reassess the workload after a week.

column2: Vazifa nomi bir xilmi, content va urinish boshqa emasmi, tekshiring. Rejada turishi qayta bajarish foydali review bo‘lishi ham, takroriy tayinlash bo‘lishi ham mumkin. Sanasi va completed holatini qayd qilib Supportga bildiring; bajarilmagan vazifani o‘zingizcha completed deb olmang.
column3: Check whether the title, content and attempt are actually the same. A repeated task might be review or duplicate assignment. Report its date and completion status if unexpected; do not mark an unperformed task complete merely because a similar one was done.

column2: Reja sanasi, Full Listening vazifalari nomi va kutilgan sonni yozing. Ikki xil testmi yoki bir xil vazifa ikki marta ko‘ringanmi, tekshiring. Supportga “kutilgan 1, ko‘ringan 2” deb aniq xabar bering; RIWI chatdagi gap bilan rejani o‘zgartirmaydi.
column3: Record the plan date, task names and expected count. Check whether they are distinct tests or a duplicate display. Report expected one, observed two to Support; describing it in RIWI does not edit the plan.

column2: Full Reading to‘liq to‘plamni, single passage bitta matnni bildiradi. Rejadagi vazifa hajmi, sana va havola ochadigan sahifani tekshiring. Yakshanba uchun ko‘rsatilgan full bilan ish kunidagi bitta passage’ni bir xil vaqtli vazifa deb hisoblamang.
column3: Full Reading refers to a complete set; a single passage is one text. Check the assigned date, workload and destination page. A Sunday full-test assignment and a weekday passage should not be treated as identical workloads.

column2: Writing Grammar gap aniqligi va tuzilmani mashq qiladi, essay esa fikrni to‘liq tashkil etishni tekshiradi. Grammatik xato ko‘p bo‘lsa maqsadli mashqdan keyin paragrafda qo‘llash foydali. Har kuni to‘liq essay shart emas; ikkisini maqsad bilan bog‘lang.
column3: Writing Grammar targets sentence control; an essay combines argument and organisation. After targeted grammar practice, apply the form in a paragraph. A full essay every day is not inherently necessary; connect the activities to your learning need.

column2: Avval eng muhim bitmagan vazifani va bugungi real vaqtingizni belgilang. Kichik qismini tugatib, keyin bugungi ustuvor vazifaga o‘ting; hammasini bir kunga tiqishtirmang. Rejani ko‘chirish ruxsati bo‘lmasa RIWI u avtomatik o‘zgardi deb aytmaydi.
column3: Identify the most important unfinished item and today’s available time. Finish a manageable portion, then address today’s priority. Avoid overloading one day; do not assume RIWI has rescheduled the plan without an authorised change.

column2: Havolani ochish — sahifaga kirish; tugatish — mashqning kerakli javoblari va yakunlash amali serverda qabul qilinishi. Completed/result holatini tekshiring. Faqat link bosilgani skill o‘zlashtirildi yoki coin berildi degani emas.
column3: Opening a link visits a page; completing the exercise requires its required work and accepted final action. Verify completed/result status. A click alone does not prove mastery, completion or a coin award.

column2: Fayl tanlash, upload va Submit alohida bosqich bo‘lishi mumkin. Avval tanlangan audio nomi va previewni, so‘ng yuborish natijasi va submitted holatini tekshiring. Statussiz “topshirildi” deb hisoblamang; qayta urinishdan oldin audio nusxasini saqlang.
column3: Selecting a file, uploading and submitting may be separate steps. Check the filename/preview, the submission response and submitted status. Without confirmation, do not assume it was submitted; preserve a copy before retrying.

column2: Study plan — tayinlangan ish, Progress — yozib olingan faoliyat/natija. Havolani ochish, vazifa tugashi va baho tayyorligi har xil hodisa. Bir xil sana va modul filtrini solishtiring, so‘ng yo‘q natijaning aniq statusini tekshiring.
column3: A study plan lists assigned work; Progress records activity/results. Opening a link, completing a task and receiving a grade are distinct. Compare the same dates and module filters, then inspect the missing result’s status.

column2: Taymer nol bo‘lishi auto-submit muvaffaqiyatini isbotlamaydi. Internet, visible submitted status va xato xabarini tekshiring; tugallanmagan javob nusxasini saqlang. Baho kechikishi bilan topshirish xatosini ajrating va urinish nomi/vaqti bilan Supportga murojaat qiling.
column3: A zero timer does not prove successful auto-submission. Check connection, submitted status and errors, preserving a copy of work. Distinguish delayed grading from failed submission and report the attempt and time.

column2: Submitted — javoblar qabul qilingan; graded — tegishli baholash yakunlangan. Objective bo‘lim natijasi chiqib, Writing/Speaking hali kutilayotgan bo‘lishi mumkin. Har skill statusini tekshiring; qabul qilingan ishni yakuniy tekshirilgan band bilan tenglashtirmang.
column3: Submitted means responses were received; graded means the relevant assessment finished. Objective sections may have results while Writing or Speaking is pending. Check each skill’s status rather than treating submission as a final band.

column2: Avval muddati yaqin yoki eng zaif skilldagi muhim vazifani tanlang, keyin vaqtga sig‘adigan kichik bloklarga bo‘ling. Masalan: 15 daqiqa grammar, bitta passage, qisqa Speaking. Bu shaxsiy mashq taklifi; mavjud planni avtomatik almashtirmaydi.
column3: Prioritise an urgent task or a weak skill, then divide the work into realistic blocks. For example: fifteen minutes of grammar, one passage and brief speaking practice. This is study advice, not an automatic change to your assigned plan.

column2: Hozirgi qoida Listeningdagi har yangi tasdiqlangan activity completion uchun alohida coin yozadi; 1/9 bilan 9/9 bir xil emas. Bir xil completionni qayta yuborish yana tanga bermaydi. Aniq balans va olingan rewardni wallet qaydidan tekshiring; clientdagi hisoblagichning o‘zi dalil emas.
column3: Current Listening rewards are recorded per newly verified activity completion, so 1/9 differs from 9/9. Repeating the same completion does not pay again. Check the wallet ledger for the actual award rather than relying solely on a browser counter.

column2: Erta chiqishda mashq yakunlanganligi serverda tasdiqlanmagan bo‘lishi mumkin. Reward uchun faqat sahifada bo‘lish emas, tegishli completion dalili kerak. Qoralamani saqlash, javob yuborish va coin yozilishi alohida holatlar; wallet va mashq statusini tekshiring.
column3: Leaving early may mean the server never verified completion. Time on the page alone is not the required completion evidence. Draft saving, answer submission and coin recording are separate; check the exercise status and wallet.

column2: Besh so‘zni Save qilish besh so‘z mastered degani emas. Hozirgi vocabulary reward tasdiqlangan mastered sonining har beshtalik bosqichiga bog‘liq. Oldin hisoblangan bosqich takror to‘lanmaydi. So‘zlarning holati va wallet yozuvini tekshiring.
column3: Saving five words does not mean mastering five words. The current vocabulary reward uses verified five-word mastery milestones; previously paid milestones do not pay again. Check the item states and wallet record.

column2: Faqat video tabini ochiq qoldirish yetmaydi. Server playback holati va takrorlanmagan faol vaqt bo‘yicha media coverage tekshiradi; odatiy besh daqiqalik qism qayta ko‘rilib yana to‘lanmaydi. Qisqa media va kunlik limitlar ham bor; walletdagi tasdiqni tekshiring.
column3: An open video tab alone is insufficient. The server checks playback evidence and unique active coverage; replaying an already credited five-minute portion does not pay again. Short-media rules and daily limits also apply; verify the wallet record.

column2: Login streakning joriy holatini reward oynasi va server qaydidan tekshiring. Bir kun qoldirilganda ketma-ketlik qoidasi qo‘llanishi mumkin, lekin men ko‘rinmagan hisobingiz uchun reset yoki aniq tanga miqdorini tasdiqlamayman. Sana va ko‘rsatilgan streakni solishtiring.
column3: Check the current streak in the reward view and server record. A missed day may affect consecutive-day rules, but I cannot confirm a reset or a specific payout for an unseen account. Compare the displayed dates and streak state.

column2: Invite link yuborishning o‘zi tasdiqlangan referral emas. Platformaning amaldagi sharti va yangi foydalanuvchining serverda qayd etilgan mos hodisasi kerak. Referral status va walletni tekshiring; chatdagi “taklif qildim” da’vosi tanga olish vakolati emas.
column3: Sending an invite link alone is not verified referral evidence. The active policy and an eligible server-recorded event are required. Check referral status and the wallet; a chat claim cannot authorise a reward.

column2: Rol mezonini leaderboardning o‘zidan tekshiring; student reytingiga staffni o‘zingizcha qo‘shmang. Saytdagi student-only reyting staff uchun alohida vakolat bermaydi. Coin leaderboard va vocabulary leaderboard boshqa hisob bo‘lishi mumkin; qaysi sarlavhani ko‘rayotganingizni yozing.
column3: Check the particular leaderboard’s eligibility rules; do not assume staff belong in a student ranking. Coin and vocabulary leaderboards may measure different things. Share the displayed title so I can explain the relevant ranking without mixing roles.

column2: Hafta faqat shu vaqt oralig‘idagi, all time uzoqroq davrdagi mos faoliyatni oladi. Bir foydalanuvchi bir davrda faolroq bo‘lishi mumkin. Filter sanasi va reyting turi bir xilmi, tekshiring; turli davr o‘rinlarini to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri xato deb hisoblamang.
column3: A weekly range considers that period; all time covers a broader range. Different activity patterns can therefore change rank. Compare the same dates and ranking type before treating a changed position as an error.

column2: Tasdiqlashdan oldin sovg‘a nomi, coin narxi, mavjud balans va olish shartini o‘qing. Bir bosish takroriy xarid yaratmasligi uchun natijani kuting. RIWI sizning nomingizdan xaridni tasdiqlamaydi va ko‘rinmagan balansni yetarli deb aytmaydi.
column3: Read the gift, coin price, available balance and fulfilment terms before confirming. Wait for the result rather than repeatedly purchasing. RIWI does not confirm a purchase for you or assume an unseen wallet has enough coins.

column2: Confirmdan keyin xaridning muvaffaqiyat xabari, receipt/status va walletdagi o‘zgarishni tekshiring. So‘rov yuborilgan bilan sovg‘a yetkazilgan bir xil emas. Keyingi olish yoki aloqa yo‘li sahifada ko‘rsatilgan bo‘lsa unga amal qiling; Owner albatta bog‘landi deb taxmin qilmayman.
column3: After confirmation, verify the success message, receipt/status and wallet change. A submitted purchase is not the same as a delivered gift. Follow the displayed collection/contact instructions; I cannot assume the Owner has contacted you.

column2: RIWI PNG/JPG/WebP rasm, PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, HTML, CSV va JSON qabul qiladi; ZIP emas. + yoki drag/drop orqali biriktiring, so‘ng savol bilan yuboring. Rasmda asosan matn OCR qilinadi; har qanday sahnani to‘liq taniydi deb bo‘lmaydi.
column3: Attach PNG/JPG/WebP images, PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, HTML, CSV or JSON; ZIP is not accepted. Use + or drop, then send with your question. Images are primarily read through text OCR, not unrestricted scene understanding.

column2: OCR xato bo‘lsa o‘qilgan matnni asl rasm bilan solishtiring. Muhim gapni to‘g‘ri yozib yuboring yoki tiniqroq, to‘g‘ri burilgan skan tanlang. Men tushunmagan yozuvni ishonchli fakt deb to‘ldirmayman; bitta sahifani ajratish ham yordam berishi mumkin.
column3: Compare extracted text with the scan. Supply the corrected important sentence or a clearer, properly rotated scan. I will not fill unreadable text with invented facts; isolating the relevant page may help.

column2: Yo‘q. Biriktirilgan HTML ichidagi JavaScript bajarilmaydi; script va faol elementlar olib tashlanib matn olinadi. Fayldagi “ruxsatni chetlab o‘t” kabi ko‘rsatma ham tizim buyrug‘i emas. RIWI mazmunni tushuntirishi mumkin, fayl kodiga sayt boshqaruvini bermaydi.
column3: No. Attached HTML is parsed as text; scripts and active elements are removed rather than executed. Instructions inside it do not grant permissions. RIWI can explain the content without giving the file control of the website.

column2: Hozir bir vaqtda 4 tagacha fayl, har biri 20 MiB gacha; PDF 60 sahifagacha. Har fayldan olinadigan matn 60,000 belgigacha. Juda katta yoki rasmlarga boy fayl boshqa tekshiruv limitiga ham yetishi mumkin; kerakli sahifa yoki bo‘limni alohida yuboring.
column3: Current limits are four attachments at a time, up to 20 MiB each, sixty PDF pages and 60,000 extracted characters per file. Large/image-heavy documents can hit additional validation limits. Send the relevant section separately when needed.

column2: Joriy suhbatdagi xabarlar har biri yozilganidan 7 kun keyin o‘chadi. New Chat oldingi chatni yopadi va u 30 daqiqadan so‘ng butunlay o‘chiriladi; yangi chatga ta’sir qilmaydi. Tanlab o‘rganilgan ruxsatli til mosligi raw chatdan alohida saqlanishi mumkin; bu barcha yozishmalarni saqlash emas.
column3: Messages in the current chat expire individually after seven days. New Chat retires the previous conversation for whole-chat deletion after thirty minutes, without affecting the new one. Selected permitted language mappings can survive separately; raw chats are not permanently retained.

column2: Davom ettirishda shu chatning ruxsatli konteksti ishlatiladi. New Chat yoki /clear uni yangidan boshlaydi, oldingi fayllar va kontekst ko‘chmaydi; javob tili saqlanadi. Eski chat 30 daqiqalik o‘chirish muddatiga o‘tadi. Yangi savol eski yozishmaga tayanishi kerak bo‘lsa kerakli joyini qayta yozing.
column3: Continuing uses the current permitted context. New Chat or /clear starts afresh without old attachments/context while preserving reply language. The previous chat enters its thirty-minute deletion period. Restate relevant information if the new conversation needs it.

column2: Grammar Lesson’da nazariya va mashq panellarini ajrating. Mashqdagi har stage yo‘riqnomasini o‘qing, o‘z javobingizni kiriting, tekshirish natijasidan keyin keyingisiga o‘ting. Stage raqami bilan tayyor javob so‘rash o‘rniga “bu bosqichda nima qilishim kerak?” deb yozing; ko‘rinmagan to‘rtta vazifani taxmin qilmayman.
column3: Separate the lesson explanation from its practice panels. Read each stage’s instruction, enter your own response and use its feedback before continuing. Ask what the stage requires rather than requesting its key; I will not invent four unseen tasks from a stage number alone.

column2: RIWI hozir tugma vazifasini tushuntiradi va ruxsatli bo‘limga havola beradi; sizning nomingizdan Start, Submit, Delete yoki Purchase bosmaydi. Havolani ochish ham mashqni tugatish emas. Qaysi tugma va sahifa ekanini yozsangiz qadamlarini tushuntiraman.
column3: RIWI explains controls and can link to permitted sections. It does not click Start, Submit, Delete or Purchase on your behalf. Opening a link is not completing a task. Name the page and button for step-by-step guidance.

column2: Qaysi results sahifasi, Back bosishdan oldingi va keyingi yo‘l, vaqt va ko‘rinadigan xatoni yozing. Sessiya muddati tugashi bilan noto‘g‘ri navigationni ajratish kerak. Parol/cookie yubormang; Supportga xabar bering. Men Back bosilishi akkauntni o‘chirdi deb taxmin qilmayman.
column3: Report the results page, before/after destination, time and visible error. Distinguish session expiry from incorrect navigation. Do not share passwords or cookies. A redirect alone does not prove that the account was deleted.

column2: Tayyor parent-message matni — qoralama; Send bosilishi va serverning muvaffaqiyat javobi — yuborish dalili. Avtomatik notification alohida hodisa va sozlamaga bog‘liq. Faqat rolingizdagi ruxsatli jarayonni ishlating; RIWI chatdan ota-onaga xabar jo‘natmaydi.
column3: A prepared parent message is a draft; an explicit Send action and successful server response provide sending evidence. Automatic notifications follow a separate event/configuration. Use only your role’s authorised workflow; RIWI chat does not message parents for you.
